properties.name: Primary NORDREG Deep-Water Route (Resolute Bay Corridor)
properties.description: Deep-water mid-channel passage transiting Barrow Strait past Resolute Bay (74.7° N, 95.0° W). Fastest passage during open-water periods.
properties.key_hazard_area: Vulnerable to multi-year ice intrusion funneled southward from Wellington Channel and McDougall Sound.

properties.name: Alternate Southern Bypass Route (Somerset Island Coast)
properties.description: Southern route hugging Somerset Island northern coast. Sheltered from northerly multi-year ice intrusions during late-season choke events.
properties.key_hazard_area: Shallower bathymetry closer to coast; potential localized coastal fast ice during late freeze-up.
